annotations.title: Pause, resume, or publish a listing

description: Use this to pause one of the user's listings (hidden from the marketplace; pending proposals for it are closed), resume a paused one, or publish a draft. status is ACTIVE or PAUSED. Confirm with the user first, since pausing closes proposals.

status.description: ACTIVE to publish or resume, PAUSED to hide
